changelog: Figurines and episodes added from the web app now work right away, without restarting the player, and character names keep their capitals and accents. Removing a figurine from the web app works again. New in the web app: a 3-step wizard for new characters (name and photo, figurine, first episodes), moving a figurine from another character, names for figurines, watched/to-watch episodes with a 'start the round again' button, renaming episodes, an upload queue with per-file progress and cancel, and photos shrunk on the phone before upload. State files are now written atomically, so a power cut can no longer truncate them.
